\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{به} \fa{تازگی} (be-tâzegi)}{به تازگی (be-tâzegi)}]{\fa{به} \fa{تازگی} (be-tâzegi) — recently}

\label{lesson:FA-C137-be-tazegi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for surely ... not?, then the Persian for when.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{به} \fa{تازگی}}
\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{تازگی}} — \emph{be-tâzegi} — \textquotedblleft{}recently\textquotedblright{}. Persian's past for \textquotedblleft{}I\textquotedblright{} ends in \textbf{-am}: \textbf{\fa{به} \fa{تازگی} \fa{یک} \fa{کتاب} \fa{خواندم}} — \emph{be-tâzegi yek ketâb khândam} — \textquotedblleft{}I recently read a book.\textquotedblright{}
